Yamato: "Huh? Fain's signal disappeared..."
Fain: "Hehehehehehe..."
Touya: "Hey, Yamato, he's over there."
Yamato: "Oh, isn't that the Dusseldorf, meow?
Hmm... Fain's rubbing his cheek against it..."
Touya: "He's just that happy, right?"
Fain: "My Spirit Mech!
Hehe, hehehehehe..."
Yamato: "Shall we leave him alone for now?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Fain: "Hm? Oh, what's up?
Have you come to study cool opening speeches too?"
Touya: "...No, that's not one of my hobbies."
Fain: "...You're a strange fellow. What other reason would you have
to come here?"
Touya: "Don't lump me in with you."
Fain: "Aha! You're planning to make your own
behind my back, aren't you?!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Well, shall we go?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Fain: "Hehehe... You would try to keep something from Fain Jin Barion,
would you...? Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Fain: "Ahaa, just as I thought..."
Touya: "Come on, let's go."
Yamato: "Oh, wait, Touya!"
Yamato: "Isn't she still looking into it, meow?
We shouldn't bother her."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Celica: "Sorry, I can't step away right now. Come back later."
Touya: "...Looks like she's not giving us an opening."
Yamato: "She's probably analyzing that part, meow."
Touya: "Yeah. Let's come back later for now..."
Celica: "...Yeees... Come in..."
Celica: "Yaaaaawn...
Touya: "Were you sleeping?"
Celica: "No, I'm fine.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:03><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:16:02><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:16:F0> I just finished the analysis, and I was only
dozing a little."
Touya: "I see. Did you find anything out?"
Celica: "More or less. I'll explain the details later,
but this will be solid evidence."
Yamato: "So the ≪Ze=Ode≫ were involved after all?"
Celica: "More or less. But I'm more interested in
Bernst, who picked out this part.
At first glance, it's nothing out of the ordinary,
except for one thing. This control crystal here is crucial."
Yamato: "Let me see... Whoa, it's tiny!"
Celica: "Right? You wouldn't notice it unless you knew
what it was. And he managed to pick that out...
I'd have chosen somewhere else. It's frustrating to admit."
Touya: "Couldn't it have been a coincidence?"
Celica: "If so, his luck rating would be
astronomical."
Touya: "Bernst, huh..."
Celica: "Well, anyway, our guess is now confirmed.
That's a step forward."
We owe that step to you.
But that's one very big step.
Celica: "Huh? Y-Yeah. Thank you..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Celica: "No, it's just that I didn't expect
you to say something like that... But hearing you say it
makes me happy."
Touya: "Want me to praise you some more?"
Celica: "Hehehe, some other time.
I want to look into this a little more."
Yamato: "Well, let's get going."
Touya: "Huh? O-Oh, yeah..."
Celica: "Yes. But this alone still isn't enough.
We'll have to investigate a little more.
I'm counting on you from here on too, Touya."
Touya: "Yeah. I don't know if I can live up
to those expectations,
but I'll do my best not to disappoint you."
Celica: "Mm-hmm. Well, I'll look into this
a little more."
Yamato: "Well, let's get going."
Touya: "Huh? O-Oh, yeah..."
